footnotes: p. 75 n. 1: on 'Neb-er-t'er]' (end of the bracketed Naville passage, not read): The passage in brackets is supplied from Naville, Todtenbuch, Bd. I., Bl. 31.
p. 75 n. 2: on 'sami' (A line 2): Var. [hieroglyphs] ḥait.
p. 75 n. 3: on the second 'Teṭṭeṭu' (end of § A): In many papyri the order of this and of the following sections is changed.
p. 76 n. 1: on 'χeft - f' (B line 3): The papyrus of Nebseni adds [hieroglyphs] "as thou didst make Osiris to triumph over his enemies."
p. 76 n. 2: on 'em' (B line 3, 'before'): Var. [hieroglyphs] embaḥ, "before."
p. 77 n. 1: on 'Set' (D line 2): The variants are [three hieroglyphic spellings of Set].
notes: Section boundaries match the brief: § A at p.75 row 3, § B p.76 row 1, § C p.76 row 7, § D p.77 row 6, § E p.78 row 4. Line numerals: A 1-4; B 1-4 (3 printed inside ḥebs, which keeps line 2); C 1-4; D 1-4 (3 printed inside χefta - f on p.78 row 1, which keeps line 2); E 1-4. p.78 has no footnotes. Overlines: p.75 row3 àr..Ànnu, row4 àr/saiu/sebàu, row5 à; p.76 row1 àr..Teṭṭeṭu, row2 àr..Teṭ (to end of row), row3 em Teṭṭeṭu, row4 à, row7 àr..Seχem; p.77 row1 àr..χaut, row2 the festival group and à, row6 àr, row7 t'at'at..Ṭept, row8 àr..en, row9 à; p.78 row4 àr..Taiu(?)-reχit, row5 à. English glosses spanning two words: 'the daybreak' (ḥet' ta) assigned to ḥet'; 'making him to be established' spans smen-tu nef; 'heir of the things of' split heir/āuāt, of/em.
